meta.title: The Wird Garden
meta.description: Memorize the Quran at your own pace and watch your garden grow.

hero.subtitle: Memorize the Quran at your own pace, your own way. Every surah you keep in your heart blooms in your garden.

items.title: Recite
items.text: Choose how you memorize: by ayah, by third, by half page or by page. Listen to the audio and repeat as many times as you need.

items.title: Remember
items.text: Reviewing is watering. Every day the app tells you what to review so nothing wilts.

items.title: Bloom
items.text: Every surah you memorize becomes a new plant in your garden.

garden.title: Every surah, a plant
garden.text: The longer the surah, the bigger what blooms. No one competes with anyone: the garden is yours alone.

name.title: From wird to ward
name.wirdLabel: Your daily portion of the Quran
name.text: In Arabic they are written with the same letters, and only one vowel changes. Day by day, your wird becomes a garden of roses.

items.title: A plan made for you
items.text: Guided day by day or at your own pace. Start with Al-Fatiha or with Juz' Amma.

items.title: Audio by ayah
items.text: Renowned reciters and automatic repetition of what you are memorizing.

items.title: Self-test mode
items.text: Hide the text and recite from memory to check what you already know.

items.title: An assistant by your side
items.text: Helps you plan your review and explains the meaning of what you memorize, citing its sources.
